## Giant Ant Worker (CR 1)

XP—  
N Medium celestial/fiendish vermin  
**Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +5  


**Defenses**


**AC** 15, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+5 natural)  
**hp** 18 [22] (2d8+9) [2d8+13]  
**Fort** +6 [+8], **Ref** +0, **Will** +1  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects  
**SR** 6  
**Celestial – Resist** acid, cold, and electricity 5  
**Fiendish – Resist** cold and fire 5  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., climb 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +3 [+5] (1d6+2 [1d6+4])  
**Special Attack** smite evil/good  


**Statistics**


**Str** 14 [18], **Dex** 10, **Con** 17 [21], Int— , **Wis** 13, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3 [+5] (+7 [+9] vs grapple); **CMD** 13 [15] (21 [23] vs trip)  
**Feats** Toughness **Skills** Climb +10, Perception +5, Survival +5  


**Special Abilities**


**Smite evil/good** Giant ant drones that are celestial or fiendish can smite good (if fiendish) or evil (if celestial) 1/day as a swift action (adds Cha bonus (+0) to attack rolls and damage bonus equal to HD (+2) against evil/good foes; smite persists until target is dead or the celestial/fiendish creature rests).  

**Augment Summoning**: Modifiers within brackets ([]) represent the spell being cast by a character with the Augment Summoning feat.
